messages:
miriam: Heads-up — midnight provisioning runbook for rack-17 scheduled 00:30 UTC. Need final owner confirm and CR review ping. TL;DR: H100 x8 arriving, cable kits incomplete, thermal sweep required. @josh @prasanna

deploy-bot: runbook ticket INF-4827 created and scheduled for 00:30 UTC — notes attached.

josh: I'm doing node prep + rack staging. I can be on-site by 23:45 UTC. Who's taking CR review? Also confirming we have IPMI creds (rotated last week?).

prasanna: I can take CR review for firmware/driver changes. Post the config diff or gist. Also, we need a rotation window for KMS if we touch keys.

miriam: quick diff pasted below (small):
```
- driver: nvidia-driver 510.47
+ driver: nvidia-driver 515.65
+ firmware: h100-fw-52.3
```
Smoke checks to run during provisioning (add to runbook):
```bash
ssh admin@rack17-node01 'nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,temperature.gpu --format=csv'
./infra-health-check.sh --nodes node01..node06
```
Also confirm IPMI creds are in lastpass entry "infra/rack17".

sam: I can run thermal sweep during the window. Note: cooling floor will be in reduced mode 00:00-01:00 UTC for scheduled work — ops already alerted. If that persists we may need to delay or run reduced parallelism.

josh: Cable kits: manifest shows 8 kits but 2x SFP+ breakout cables missing. Procurement ETA for missing pieces is 02:00 UTC. I can bring adapters from staging bench (QSFP->SFP) as fallback — ok to use those?

miriam: Use adapters as fallback and record in ticket as fallback plan. If adapters are not suitable, we start 6 nodes and leave 2 offline. Update dedicated reservation to reflect fallback plan. @deploy-bot please tag INF-4827 with fallback=6nodes.

deploy-bot: INF-4827 updated: fallback=6nodes, cr_reviewer=prasanna, thermal_owner=sam.

prasanna: Quick CR note: firmware 52.3 includes NVL link fix, LGTM. Only ask is to stagger reboots by ~30s to avoid power inrush when rolling GPUs.

miriam: Adding runbook step: insert `sleep 30` between node reboots and include ipmi power-cycler commands:
```bash
for n in node01 node02; do ipmitool -I lanplus -H $n -U admin -P $PASS chassis power cycle; sleep 30; done
```
Also note a one-paragraph ops note about prefix/KV cache warmup for inference — important for first-run latency. I'll attach to the ticket before 00:15.

sam: I'll monitor temps; spare portable fans staged at rack door. Ping me if any GPU > 65C and I'll throttle.

josh: Plan for network smoke at 00:00 UTC for the first set: `for n in node01 node02 node03; do ssh $n "ethtool eth0 || true"; done` — posting results in this thread.

miriam: :thumbsup: Thanks. Final ask: if procurement blocks adapters and we can't safely cable, update this channel ASAP and we'll postpone the remaining nodes. Otherwise proceed with fallback-6nodes and note it in INF-4827. I'll close runbook PR after first infra smoke passes.

josh: 00:45 UTC — smoke complete for first 6 nodes. Temps stable, drivers OK, adapters worked fine. Observed NIC driver warning on node05 (link flaps logged) — filing INF-4829 for follow-up.

miriam: great work — marking INF-4827 as in-progress and noting the adapter fallback success. Follow-ups: INF-4829 for node05 NIC, procurement to reconcile missing cable qty. Thanks all.
